description: Publishes the DNS records the Aiddesk multi-brand helpdesk needs to verify ownership of a customer-support domain and send DKIM-signed email from it: an ownership-verification TXT, the DKIM public key, a bounce-handling CNAME and a DMARC policy record.
variableDescription: verifyToken: hex ownership token issued by the helpdesk for this domain. dkimSelector: DKIM selector generated by the helpdesk (e.g. hd2026). dkimKey: base64 DKIM public key generated by the helpdesk. dmarcParams: DMARC tags that follow v=DMARC1 (e.g. p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com).
